title: My client found my broken website before I did

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Claude! My client just called. At 11 PM. 'Why is my website broken?!'
beats.tts: [panicking, out of breath] Claude! My client just called. At eleven PM. [mimicking angry client] 'Why is my website broken?!'

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: I don't know! I found out from the client!
beats.tts: [frustrated] I don't know! I found out from the client!

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: So your client... is your monitoring tool.
beats.tts: [deadpan] So your client... [beat] is your monitoring tool.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: A little funny. Okay, this is why you need MyKavo.
beats.tts: [laughs] A little funny. [excited] Okay, this is why you need MyKavo!
beats.title: Meet MyKavo

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: It scans every page of your sites and flags anything that changes.
beats.tts: [confident] It scans every page of your sites, and flags anything that changes.
beats.title: 1. Change alerts

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Missing button? Redesigned page? Links gone? You see it first, with before and after.
beats.tts: [energetic] Missing button? Redesigned page? Links gone? [satisfied] You see it first. With before and after.
beats.title: 2. Before vs after

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Even on my client's WordPress site?
beats.tts: [curious] Even on my client's WordPress site?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: There's a WordPress plugin. And every alert is ranked, so you fix the critical stuff first.
beats.tts: [cheerful] There's a WordPress plugin! And every alert is ranked, so you fix the critical stuff first.
beats.title: 3. Critical first

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Free? Then why am I still awake?
beats.tts: [relieved laugh] Free? Then why am I still awake?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Exactly. Next time, you call the client first.
beats.tts: [teasing] Exactly. Next time... you call the client first.
